exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
outcome: Risk of overweight or obesity in infants (age-sex-specific body mass index ≥ 85th percentile) at 2 years old
cohort: 294 infants born in the Rize Province, Turkey, between November 1, 2013, and September 30, 2014
finding: Caesarean delivery was independently associated with a significantly increased risk of overweight or obesity in children by 2 years of age.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of childhood overweight or obesity at 2 years old, even after adjusting for confounders.
